expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Reports whether Span is no longer than Other. Reports whether Span is no shorter than Other. Reports whether both durations contain the same tick count.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Representative left/right operands, identity or zero operands, and one boundary value; distinguish mutating compound operators from value-returning operators.
testScope: bool bLessOrEqual = Span <= Other; | bool bGreaterOrEqual = Span >= Other; | bool bEqual = Span == Other;
